ezekiel.32.p1.b1.text: In the twelfth year, on the first day of the twelfth month

ezekiel.32.p1.b2.text: Son of man, take up a lament for Pharaoh king of Egypt

ezekiel.32.p1.b3.text: You are like a lion among the nations; you are like a monster in the seas. You thrash about in your rivers, churning up the waters with your feet and muddying the streams.

ezekiel.32.p1.b4.text: I will spread My net over you with a company of many peoples, and they will draw you up in My net.

ezekiel.32.p1.b5.text: I will cover the heavens and darken their stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.

ezekiel.32.p1.b6.text: Then I will let her waters settle and will make her rivers flow like oil

ezekiel.32.p2.b1.text: Son of man, wail for the multitudes of Egypt

ezekiel.32.p2.b2.text: Assyria is there with her whole company

ezekiel.32.p2.b3.text: Her graves are set in the depths of the Pit … those who once spread terror in the land of the living.

ezekiel.32.p2.b4.text: The fallen warriors of old, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were placed under their heads

ezekiel.32.p2.b5.text: But you too will be shattered and lie down among the uncircumcised

ezekiel.32.p2.b6.text: Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
